notes.title: Patch Notes: Labyrinth of Zangetsu Bug fixes (2023/05/22)
notes.content:
Good Morrow Adventurer, our deepest gratitude for your continued service to Zangetsu.

We come to you today with some Patch and Bug fixes to further aid your quests and ventures.

Here are the fixes:

· Crashes involving teleporter have now been vanquished.
· Maps on the camp screens have been restored.
· Background textures have been sent to their proper place.
· Thanks to the wonderful community of players several other smaller bugs have also been fixed as well as some text has been corrected.

We are still working to amend some issues regarding text and a surprise attack, thank you for your patience.

notes.title: About bug fixes
notes.content:
We have fixed the issue where the save function was not working in non-English European language environments.
Additionally, we have also addressed the bug where enemy characters were not displaying correctly.
We will continue to work on addressing these issues in the future.

notes.title: Labyrinth of Zangetsu: OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/f13d5b337eaf921d51e8edba365254ab99d28ad3.jpg[/img]

[h3][h2]Attention Conscripts...[/h2][/h3]
We're happy to announce that Labyrinth of Zangetsu is out NOW on [b]Steam, PlayStation 4 & Nintendo Switch on the 20th of April 2023.[/b] Prepare to embark on a dark and perilous journey through winding labyrinths, battling the malevolent yokai that infest this ink-stained world.

We're also happy to announce that if you're a fan of MIND≒0, Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent, Akiba's BEAT or Akiba's Trip, then there's good news! You can now recruit your favourite characters into your party in Labyrinth of Zangetsu with DLC!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072252/Labyrinth_of_Zangetsu__MIND0_Avatars/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072250/Labyrinth_of_Zangetsu__AKIBAS_TRIP_Avatars/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072241/Labyrinth_of_Zangetsu__AKIBAS_BEAT_Avatars/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072251/Labyrinth_of_Zangetsu__Adventure_Academia_The_Fractured_Continent_Avatars/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/e61916928da2c13ed7f130d347272c4f4951fd9d.png[/img]
Labyrinth of Zangetsu is a dungeon crawler with turn-based strategy combat that will test your skill as you navigate treacherous environments and engage in intense battles with terrifying yokai. 

To stand any chance against these malevolent spirits, players must customise their heroes to the fullest extent, tailoring every stat and ability to their specific needs. In this brutal world, only the most cunning and ruthless heroes will emerge victorious, their journey fuelled by the unending quest for power and survival.

With a rich and immersive storyline, Labyrinth of Zangetsu will challenge your wits, your courage, and your resolve as you venture deep into the heart of darkness to conquer the Ink of Ruin and restore light to this cursed world.

So ready your weapons, gather your team, and prepare for a journey like no other. Labyrinth of Zangetsu awaits, and the fate of this ink-stained world rests in your hands. Will you emerge victorious, or will the darkness claim you? The choice is yours.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1922960/Labyrinth_of_Zangetsu/

notes.title: About bug fixes(2023/4/20)

notes.title: Happy Halloween Conscripts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/8c80966616b3caad33bebec7f7c2b307ef79461e.png[/img]

[b]Spooky Salutations![/b]

[b]Happy Halloween conscripts![/b] Heed our warning however, and celebrate with caution as the veil between worlds is at its thinnest during Halloween so, one must be on guard in order to prevent being tainted by the Ink of Ruin!

With that being said, as long as you are knowledgeable on what to look out for, you can protect yourself and your teammates as you venture into the labyrinths. So let's share some of the main things to be aware of on your haunting endeavours. 

[h3][b]Inky Miasma[/b][/h3] 

One of the [b]tell tale signs there is a yōkai nearby[/b] is a [b]cloud of inky miasma[/b]. You can tell the potential strength of your enemy by the colour of the miasma too. If the [b]cloud is black[/b] then it is a [b]regular yōkai[/b], however if the cloud is red then you need to approach with caution. [b]Red clouds[/b] are for the [b]more powerful alpha yōkai[/b] that often have many yōkai underlings so it is likely to be a hard fought battle if you are not ready for it. Make sure you pick your battles wisely with this information!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/0c834d8ce7cdad6161d341b90f6b0c91ae64b366.png[/img]

[h3][b]Punishing Pitfalls[/b][/h3]

Each labyrinth you enter will likely have [b]traps[/b] to be aware of, one of which are[b] pitfalls[/b]. Fall in and you will [b]incur damage[/b] on your teammates! Some may be [b]disguised with fog[/b] or miasma so be sure to always [b]carry torches[/b] to light your path clearly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/e33dd4c66a3b33a4529ab2c8e4f167504d3381c9.png[/img]

There are also some pitfalls that can be [b]covered with vines[/b] which will [b]entangle you and turn you around[/b] causing you not only damage, but also to [b]become lost[/b] and that is the last thing you want inside an enemy labyrinth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/612f3b961ef0a942a6cfb94a1310e169afea0ad6.png[/img]

[h3][b]Ghostly Encounters[/b][/h3]

Yōkai are not your only thing to worry about, with the veil between worlds practically non-existent during Halloween, be prepared to encounter [b]ghostly individuals[/b] too. Whether they are harmless or not though remains to be seen, so keep your wits about you! Not all of your potential enemies within the labyrinths are there to hurt you...some are simply unlucky with their fate and wish to be left alone and some may even ask for assistance - in which case it is best to stay on their good side where possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/a29bf573212a1aadcc555b60f5a653fc8fa8622c.png[/img]

[b]Enjoy your Halloween celebrations[/b] wherever you are in the world conscripts and stay safe in the labyrinths!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1922960/Labyrinth_of_Zangetsu/

notes.title: Story Time: The Ink of Ruin Disaster
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/ad6fcf4400a6f8a3025a417bf1246bec074f65e4.png[/img]

[b]Gather round Conscripts,[/b]

Let us recall the story of the [b]'Ink of Ruin' disaster[/b] together. One must equip oneself with knowledge before the fight begins if they wish to succeed!

[h3][u]The Story Begins...[/u][/h3]
It arrived with no herald, nor fanfare. A dark corruption, seeping into the fibre of our world as if ink had stained the six lands.

Our once vibrant mountains dulled and our rivers ran black, even the heavens were cloaked in a foreboding shadow. The sun’s lustre paled, and a stagnant decay cloyed at the very souls of all who drew breath.

This sentient twisted miasma became known as the [b]Ink of Ruin.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/3abcd5b5e1965174df5ed71333f3a5bb1b3ee904.gif[/img]

The blight drove the lucky mad, death’s knell ringing in their ears. The unlucky however, mutated into nightmarish fiends, existing only to terrorize those who remained.

Corpses rose from their graves, prowling for unwitting souls to join them in the shadows. In the grip of the Ink, even inanimate objects could become savage demented beasts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/01e80b6b99795e69870d61219e3a5e704aab5e2e.gif[/img]

The people of the land fled the corruption of the Ink, forbidding any return. They called these blighted lands [b]Labyrinths.[/b]

Those who escaped the calamity lived a meagre, restless existence, terrified of the encroaching blight, never knowing peace. 

But a sole bastion of hope remained. One town that vowed to fight the Ink to the bitter end. Its name? [b]Ido.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/4a10fada472435dcebec5772f4cbc0cf492f6204.gif[/img]

This walled fortress was unique. The constant moon bathed the land below in an eternal glow, protecting it with powerful magical barriers.

Ido’s town council, along with its top occult scholars, sought a way to halt the progression of the Ink. They hoped to locate and eliminate the source of the corruption before it was too late. 

For the longest time, Ido’s walls remained closed under the draconian laws of Tokinokuni. But eventually, with the permission of the governing Shogunate, the town began to accept refugees from across the broken land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/18bead57482f112fe4549a79461b5077abb85894.gif[/img]

Those with martial, magical, or monastic expertise were conscripted for a critical mission into one of the inky labyrinths that writhed outside the castle walls.

They were to use their skills to fight the spreading corruption.

These brave, foolish adventurers were charged with eradicating the Ink. Burdened with glorious purpose, they were granted the title…[b]Blightbane.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/f694a3d6e7114c83bafd38dfc595531e5f88a5e2.gif[/img]

Where did the Ink of Ruin come from? Can we eliminate its blighted touch? Is there a way to save the damned souls of this cursed land?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1922960/Labyrinth_of_Zangetsu/

notes.title: Labyrinth of Zangetsu - Coming Early 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/5271f9cc612d5045e90f28649327b183a364bd7d.png[/img]

[b]Good day Conscripts,[/b]

Today is a welcome day indeed – we are happy to announce the coming adventure in the form of ACQUIRE’s brand new 3D RPG Dungeon Crawler; [b]Labyrinth of Zangetsu![/b]

Coming soon to [b]Steam, PS4[/b] and[b] Nintendo Switch[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/dd8510a8008e5367c1519a976920f2af85ac8c20.gif[/img]

Set in the Ido period, the world has blackened under the disaster of the Ink of Ruin. Conscript a team of warriors to venture deep into the Labyrinths to conquer and sanctify the land. Will [b]you[/b] return victorious?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/8455f9aed9c498ce656522daa0602e552413ccda.gif[/img]

Face unique and terrifying demons and [b]yokai [/b]inspired by [b]Japanese folklore[/b] as you journey to overcome this stain upon the land. Use your strength to complete each labyrinth surrounding the city and bring peace to the people once again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42821467/fde3d7ee59e401c22af2dfb4ea286201317e6a9d.gif[/img]

[u][h3]Key Features to expect:[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Uniquely illustrated visuals[/b] painted by hand with traditional Japanese inking 
[*] [b]6 playable heroes [/b]are pre-programmed into the game, but there is also an option to [b]create/build your own team of heroes[/b] with unique individual stats and abilities
[*] Frightening enemies based on [b]traditional Japanese folklore and Yokai[/b] (ghosts, ghouls, and  demons)
[*] [b]Turn based battles[/b] with various Ink Beasts in the most dangerous areas. 3 ‘front’ characters to engage and attack and 3 ‘back’ characters to defend and parry
[*] [b]Engaging narrative[/b] and overarching story to enjoy the successes of your gameplay and reflect upon your losses
[*] [b]Immersive and atmospheric soundtracks[/b] inspired by traditional Japanese music captivates you as you play
[/list]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1922960/Labyrinth_of_Zangetsu/
